# App Store, Google Play or web checkout: what do you actually keep?

> Enter your monthly app revenue and average in-app price and see what Apple (30% or 15%), Google Play and web checkout via Stripe or Paddle take, your net payout, 12-month totals, and the revenue where selling on the web beats the store cut. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [App Store vs web checkout for indie apps](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/app-store-commission-calculator/app-store-vs-web-checkout-for-indie-apps.html)
